queries.name: my_open_findings
queries.sql: SELECT title, severity, status, due_date FROM findings WHERE owner = :me AND status != 'closed' ORDER BY due_date

queries.name: overdue_findings
queries.sql: SELECT title, severity, owner, due_date FROM findings WHERE status != 'closed' AND due_date IS NOT NULL AND due_date < :today ORDER BY due_date

queries.name: unassigned_findings
queries.sql: SELECT title, severity, created_at FROM findings WHERE status != 'closed' AND (owner IS NULL OR due_date IS NULL)

queries.name: awaiting_risk_approval
queries.sql: SELECT title, severity, closure_requested_by, evidence_notes FROM findings WHERE status = 'pending_approval'

queries.name: open_by_severity
queries.sql: SELECT severity, COUNT(*) AS total FROM findings WHERE status != 'closed' GROUP BY severity
